say:0:1111112001:0.text: Doesn't seem like there's any way to get north!
say:0:1111112001:0.source_cn: 说是弗兰克在北边，但这地方根本没有往北去的路！

say:1:1111112002:0.text: If Ferranc and the Quicksand Claws are as fiery and cunning as we've been told, they'll be tucked away somewhere deep.
say:1:1111112002:0.source_cn: 如果弗兰克和流沙之爪说的一样火爆又奸诈，那应该藏得很深。
say:1:1111112002:0.male: If Ferranc and the Quicksand Claws are as fiery and cunning as we've been told, they'll be tucked away somewhere deep.
say:1:1111112002:0.female: If Ferranc and the Quicksand Claws are as fiery and cunning as we've been told, they'll be tucked away somewhere deep.

say:2:1111112003:0.text: Let's detour along the southern road first.
say:2:1111112003:0.source_cn: 先沿着南方的通路，绕道看看吧。
say:2:1111112003:0.male: Let's detour along the southern road first.
say:2:1111112003:0.female: Let's detour along the southern road first.

say:3:1111112004:0.text: Satrana, what made you lose your temper so badly just now?
say:3:1111112004:0.source_cn: 萨忒娜，你刚才突然发那么大脾气，是怎么了？

say:4:1111112005:0.text: For the Quicksand Claws to take away their free will and force them to work...
say:4:1111112005:0.source_cn: 流沙之爪竟然违背大家的意志，强迫大家劳役……

say:5:1111112006:0.text: This is the most despicable thing anyone could ever do!
say:5:1111112006:0.source_cn: 在我看来，这是世界上最不可饶恕的事！
